caption: The drawing depicts a human figure with long dark hair wearing a blue-green cloth around the waist, nailed to a black cross by the hands and feet, with arms outstretched and legs together. The figure’s skin is beige, and there are numerous red lines and markings representing wounds or blood, primarily on the arms, legs, torso, and face. The torso and face also display brown and red anatomical details, drawing attention to underlying muscles and structures. The backdrop is plain and uncolored, and the only numbers shown are “26” in small print at the lower left corner. The cross is solid black with slightly uneven horizontal and vertical beams. The hands and feet have prominent dark spots at the points where they are nailed. The figure’s head is lowered slightly to one side, and the facial features are outlined in black.
title: Plate 26: Christ Crucified, Taos: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
